name: Flawless Fel Essence
label: Quest
description: Flawless Fel Essence: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If you're going to reanimate Kroshius, you're going to need Fel fire. I can make Fel fire but it's going to require some components.
You need to bring me flawless Fel essences from three distinct regions of the world.
The Legashi Satyrs of Azshara will have the first essence type; the Jaedenar legionnaires of Jaedenar the second type and the felguard sentries of the Blasted Lands the third.
Bring me back one of each essence type and I will create the Fel fire, allowing you to reanimate Kroshius.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Don't tell anyone this but Niby is daft.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Give me a minute and I'll combine the essences into Fel fire.
